description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on the lower legs and feet.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the lower legs and feet of a patient with a diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash. The lesions are small, pink to red, and distributed across the dorsal aspects of the feet and lower legs. The rash appears non-confluent and is more prominent on the lateral aspects. The background skin tone is otherwise unremarkable. The image is well-lit and taken from a frontal perspective.
visible_findings: involvement of dorsal feet and lower legs

description.short_caption: Rash with erythematous macules and papules on the sole of the foot.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the sole of a foot with numerous small erythematous macules and papules distributed across the central and medial aspects. The lesions are discrete and non-confluent, with no visible vesicles, pustules, or ulceration. The surrounding skin appears otherwise normal. The image is well-lit and focuses on the plantar surface.

description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on the dorsal aspect of the foot.
description.detailed_description: This image shows the dorsal aspect of a foot with a diffuse erythematous maculopapular rash. The lesions are small, discrete, and scattered across the skin surface. The background skin appears otherwise normal, with no visible signs of swelling or ulceration. The photograph is well-lit, and the rash is clearly visible against the lighter skin tone.

description.short_caption: MRI scan of both feet showing soft tissue and bone structures.
description.detailed_description: This is an MRI scan of both feet, displayed in a coronal view. The image shows detailed visualization of soft tissues, bones, and joints. There appear to be areas of altered signal intensity in the soft tissues and possibly within the bones, which may suggest infection, inflammation, or other pathology. The scan is de-identified and includes a scale for reference.
visible_findings: soft tissue and bone structures visible
areas of altered signal intensity in soft tissues

description.short_caption: Erythematous maculopapular rash on the plantar surface of the foot.
description.detailed_description: This clinical photograph shows the plantar surface of a foot with numerous erythematous maculopapular lesions. The lesions are distributed diffusely across the sole, with some areas appearing more confluent. The skin surrounding the lesions appears otherwise intact, with no visible ulceration or scaling. The findings suggest an inflammatory or infectious process.

description.short_caption: MRI of the left foot showing soft tissue and bony abnormalities.
description.detailed_description: This is a sagittal MRI image of the left foot. The image shows soft tissue and bony structures, with notable abnormalities in the midfoot region. There appears to be increased signal intensity in the soft tissues and possible involvement of the adjacent bones, suggesting inflammation or infection. The image is de-identified and includes technical parameters such as slice thickness and magnification.
visible_findings: sagittal view of the left foot
increased signal intensity in soft tissues
possible bony involvement in the midfoot region
normal anatomical landmarks of the foot visible
